source_boundary_and_accounting.protocol_required_scope: full public index of electronic theses and dissertations
source_boundary_and_accounting.basis: official_documentation for the review protocol/crosswalk; observed homepage copy is insufficient to prove the actual indexed-resource boundary

basic.query_grammar: untested; candidate files use parenthesized uppercase AND/OR and double-quoted multiword/hyphenated finite literals only prospectively
basic.field_scope: untested; no field restriction is proposed or applied

advanced.query_grammar_and_control_semantics: untested; no advanced query was submitted
advanced.field_scope: visible any field/title/author name/abstract/university-publisher/subjects-keywords/department-discipline choices; behavior untested

challenge_stop.event: Direct HTTP retrieval of public OATD FAQ returned HTTP 403 with Cf-Mitigated: challenge and a Just a moment Cloudflare page.
challenge_stop.rule: No source query, challenge interaction, credential entry, retry loop, endpoint substitution, or access workaround was attempted after this observation.

candidate_syntax.phrases: double quotes around every multiword or hyphenated finite literal in candidate files
candidate_syntax.boolean: uppercase AND/OR with explicit parentheses in candidate files
candidate_syntax.not: No normative partition requires NOT; visible basic/advanced behavior is not validated.
candidate_syntax.pair_rules: candidate same-record Boolean conjunctions; no unvalidated proximity claim

date.observed: Visible advanced earliest/latest text controls only; no date format, inclusivity, record date field, or exact-day behavior was tested.
date.future_rule: After a challenge-free re-pilot and P-001 cutoff, test exact-day endpoints using controlled singleton/date probes. If OATD cannot natively express both inclusive endpoints, exhaust and preserve the unaltered validated source result before applying a documented local exact-day comparison to captured OATD date-label fields; retain unresolved precision and do not screen during that operation.

language.observed: Visible advanced language selector includes English, but no semantic behavior was tested.
language.future_rule: Apply no language control unless a future pilot validates it. Full-report English remains a later screening criterion; metadata never proves full-report language.

controls_for_future_final_event.current_pilot_applied_limits: none; no search query was submitted

result_identity_and_completeness.stable_identity_candidate: Do not adopt a stable identity until a future current Record Details route proves a visible OATD Record ID and an unescaped route value agree.
result_identity_and_completeness.repository_and_resource_rule: Do not treat repository/university/publisher metadata or a resource URL as an OATD stable ID, proof of a working repository link, accessible full text, completed degree work, language, or eligibility.
result_identity_and_completeness.future_procedure: After the challenge-free grammar/boundary pilot, validate source total/range, page size/pagination, Record Details route, Record ID, duplicate behavior, and two complete comparable ID passes before any final result capture. Any change in total/order, short page, missing/duplicate ID, inaccessible expected result page, parse failure, cap, or unreconciled range sets total null and prohibits import.

transport.candidate_submission: Use the normal visible basic OATD form: GET /oatd/search with q equal to the UTF-8 file text after removing exactly its terminal LF and visible hidden form=basic.
transport.basis: observed route/form controls; untested candidate q grammar and echo

fields.value: No field restriction; prospective basic q candidate.

current_interface_validation.reason: No query cell was submitted after a public OATD documentation request returned a Cloudflare managed challenge.

lossless_union.method: single prospective cell only; not a source-validated union
lossless_union.boolean_proof: If and only if current OATD basic q accepts the preserved parenthesized AND/OR/quoted-literal candidate without rewrite, this one cell is the unsplit normative expression; no distributive split or count-derived union is claimed.
lossless_union.future_stable_record_id_union_rule: If current OATD rejects or truncates a full candidate, define every replacement cell prospectively using a Boolean distributive proof, run every cell completely twice after access is available, verify each OATD Record ID, retain cell provenance, and take only the set union of complete cell ID sets. Any failed/missing cell makes the partition total null; never infer a union from counts.
